title: Customer directory
statementMd:
List each customer's name, city and segment.

Expected columns: `name`, `city`, `segment`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, city, segment FROM customers;
```
